honesty_boundary: No component labeled 'clinically validated' (regulatory term of art). Each component carries its strongest HONEST earned tier from real outcome-linked cohorts. 'COHORT_VALIDATED_RUO' requires EPV>=10 AND CI excluding None in >=1 endpoint. 'COHORT_TESTED_NULL' = tested on a real cohort, no significant association (honest, evidence-backed). 'BORDERLINE_RUO' = 5<=exposed<10 (underpowered). 'INSUFFICIENT_EVENTS' = <5 exposed. 'DISCOVERY_ONLY' (5.3 models) = OOF AUC 95% CI spans 0.5.

v2_changelog: Added curatedOvarianData external-replication (Stream A), pooled expression/OS re-test (Stream B), and pooled resistance recalibration (Stream C). Backward-compatible: all v1.0 keys retained. New: cohorts_v2, genes_52[*].external_replication, model_53_v2, stream_summaries. No 'clinically validated' label.

cohorts_v2.pull_method: Rscript export to gene-symbol CSV + pData; serous-filtered at analysis time
cohorts_v2.independence_rule: TCGA_eset + TCGA.RNASeqV2_eset EXCLUDED from replication of any gene fit on TCGA-OV; GSE63885 not in this set so all curatedOV cohorts independent for MFAP4.
cohorts_v2.anti_fabrication: Resistance label = recurrence<183d (event & time both present); never imputed. Serous filter on histological_type. Excluded cohorts logged.

logit_resistance_probability_expr.design: Pooled leave-one-cohort-out nested CV; EXPRESSION features (z-scored per cohort); L2 logistic, class-balanced.
logit_resistance_probability_expr.feature_channel_note: Features are EXPRESSION z-scores of resistance-candidate genes, NOT somatic-mutation flags. This is a distinct feature space from the report's mutation-based genomic logit. Reported as an expression-based resistance classifier.
logit_resistance_probability_expr.honesty_statement: Bootstrap OOF-AUC CI stably excludes 0.5 (100% of seeds), meeting the pre-specified CI rule; however the within-cohort permutation test p=0.055 does NOT confirm at alpha=0.05. Therefore this is labeled CALIBRATED_RUO_BORDERLINE, NOT robustly calibrated. Event-limited (52 events, raw EPV 3.7). Brier 0.225 indicates modest calibration. NOT 'clinically validated'.
logit_resistance_probability_expr.relation_to_v1_model_53: v1 model_53 tested a MUTATION-based genomic logit (DISCOVERY_ONLY, OOF AUC 0.489). This v2 model is a distinct EXPRESSION-based classifier on 518 pooled samples/52 events. They are complementary, not the same model. v1 model_53 verdict retained above.

stream_A_external_replication.CCNE1: expression-channel replicates direction (CNA channel not externally replicable here)
stream_A_external_replication.BRCA2: expression channel opposite direction; mutation model NOT replicated

stream_B_pooled_retest.NF1/KEAP1/TP53BP1: nominal only, fail FDR, no upgrade
